control.description-key: FY27+ State-Rollup spend plan: one section per (Fund, SAG) bucket for a State and fiscal year, with Planned, Actual and Variance bands across the 12 federal fiscal year months (Oct-Sep). Funded amount per bucket is the rollup of the state's distributed, non-breakout Prioritization Fundings at that Fund/SAG (read-only). Hosted on a custom page keyed by State + Fiscal Year; rows are stored on book_spendplan anchored by book_state + book_fund + book_sag.
